meta.write: enstrophy balance as an a priori
meta.tesla: exacting, not a jerk. Net production is a number. Viscosity owned this ensemble. That is not continuation.

lemmas.name: B27_net_readable
lemmas.statement: enstrophy identity, visc-owned net, and cancelled P_+ are readable together
lemmas.why: The identity holds. |P|/D sits below 0.05. Plus and minus cancel. Typed c is not written into the PDE.

lemmas.name: B27a_visc_ensemble_not_a_priori
lemmas.statement: viscosity owning the net on these packets closes a bound for classical X
lemmas.why: Ẋ < 0 on a random-phase ensemble is a reading. Leray’s dissipation did the work here. That is not continuation.

lemmas.name: B27b_cancel_not_all_data
lemmas.statement: random-phase cancellation of ∫ω·Sω is an a priori for every 3-CONC field
lemmas.why: B16d already missed. A coherent field can have P ≈ (ω·Sω)_+. Fluids did not promote a packet to a class.

lemmas.name: B27c_decay_not_continuation
lemmas.statement: a decaying L² packet is a continuation argument for classical X
lemmas.why: X falling here does not bound X on a live cubic. B23 already refused DNS-never-blew-up. So does a cancelled net.

lemmas.name: B27d_net_not_integral_max
lemmas.statement: the enstrophy identity is an integral bound on the max vorticity
lemmas.why: Ẋ = 2P − 2D is L². A fat-packet ratio ‖ω‖_∞/‖ω‖₂ ~ 0.2 is not ∫‖ω‖_∞. Do not improve the identity into the max.

lemmas.name: B27e_coherent_leftover
lemmas.why: The net is scored. The leftover close on a coherent CONC field is B17e. Not a bigger FFT. Do not spawn n=64.

lemmas.name: B27f_not_a_pde_retune
lemmas.statement: scoring the enstrophy balance as not an a priori is a retune of classical Navier–Stokes
lemmas.why: The PDE is untouched. The net is a knob on the estimate: a cancellation you can miss. No Q1. No ε.

next_da_move: Packet geometry is not an a priori (B14d). Stretching budget is not an a priori (B15e). Enstrophy balance is not an a priori (B16e). Coherent leftover is B17e. Finer (n>32) stays a box knob (B22e). Do not spawn n=64. B4c stands. Do not cancel to Φ.
